text: [image]Oct 1, 2026 ∙ 1 minFahy, Romero Release Letter Regarding Albany's Proposed City BudgetSenator Patricia Fahy and Assemblymember Gabriella Romero released a letter they sent to Mayor Dr. Dorcey Applyrs regarding the City of Albany's proposed budget and revenue raisers. They identified four key areas, including minimizing property tax increases.30

[image]Oct 5, 2026 ∙ 1 minAlbany Times Union: More than 80% of NY's home-schooled students are chronically absentMore than 80% of students who transitioned to home schooling in New York have been chronically absent in recent years. It highlights a breakdown in a system that was further exposed in the case involving four Mechanicville children who were pulled out of school two years ago and later murdered by their mother and maternal grandmother.40

[image]Oct 5, 2026 ∙ 1 minSenator Fahy Announces $50,000 Grant for Rotterdam-Carman Little League for Updated Turf and New Batting CagesSenator Patricia Fahy announced that $50,000 in capital funds were secured through her office for Rotterdam-Carman Little League (RC Little League). Formerly Rotterdam and Carman Little Leagues, the groups merged in 2014 to form RC Little League. Carman Little League dates back decades in the Capital Region and had a famous Little League World Series run in 1977.00
